posts.title: I think that I shall never see…
posts.description: Here’s a very simple idea Find a tree, near to where you live, and go and take a photograph of it. Set a reminder on your phone to photograph the tree in three months time, and set that reminder to repeat every three months And that’s it. I’ve been doing that with the tree outside Continue reading "I think that I shall never see…"
